name: shadcn-portfolio
summary: Portfolio template built with Next.js 15, shadcn/ui and Framer Motion, with projects, skills, blog and a contact form.
description: A portfolio starter for developers or designers, built with Next.js 15 App Router, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. The homepage carries hero, skills, projects, experience, testimonials and contact sections; the project also ships a blog with MDX, light/dark mode, SEO meta tags, Lenis smooth scrolling and a contact form with Cloudflare Turnstile. A Turborepo layout, with setup documented in GETTING_STARTED.md.
contains: portfolio sections: hero, skills, projects, experience, testimonials, contact
Framer Motion animations, Lenis smooth scrolling
contact form with Cloudflare Turnstile (setup required)
